title: plastic punch bowl
text: plastic punch bowl. I mean.. it's plastic... and it's hard.... I purchased to hold a bunch of candy... and it worked... good for the price... it's just kinda cheesy.... and the edges are a bit sharp.  Get what you pay for.

description: Punch bowls are party must-haves, whether it's a baby shower, wedding, family reunion or holiday buffet, simply because there are just so many guests! Northwest Enterprises' Party Essentials 12-quart embossed punch bowl is made of crystal clear hard plastic with the look of lovely cut glass and features a timeless vine motif that blends seamlessly with a variety of party themes and decor. It measures 14.25 Inch in diameter at the top and tapers to the gracefully fluted 7-inch diameter base. The medium-weight bowl is hand washable so it can make many memorable special occasion appearances or, for quick party cleanup, it can simply be disposed of. Northwest Enterprises is a traditional family company with more than 25 years of experience in party supplies and food service disposables. Through their dedication to the high quality of their products and services, Northwest Enterprises' Party Essentials brand continues to earn a reputation as a leader in the industry and the trust and loyalty of its customers.
